name: Complete Catholic Rosary
description: App-ready Rosary data containing the Joyful, Luminous, Sorrowful, and Glorious Mysteries, including unnumbered opening and closing Sign of the Cross prayer steps and optional extended closing prayers. Every mystery includes its spiritual fruit and a brief reflection. Every mystery-decade prayer includes a distinct, mystery-appropriate Scripture reference and a related NABRE Scripture excerpt, in addition to its prayer text and unique image/audio asset paths. Mystery records also include the bundled app image key and accessible alternative text used by the Expo client.

asset_conventions.note: Bundled Rosary recordings are resolved through audio_catalog asset identifiers.

sign_of_cross.title: Sign of the Cross
sign_of_cross.text: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

apostles_creed.title: Apostles' Creed
apostles_creed.text: I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth, and in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died and was buried; he descended into hell; on the third day he rose again from the dead; he ascended into heaven, and is seated at the right hand of God the Father almighty; from there he will come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Spirit, the holy catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.

our_father.title: Our Father
our_father.text: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name; thy kingdom come; thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread; and forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us; and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen.

hail_mary.title: Hail Mary
hail_mary.text: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

glory_be.title: Glory Be
glory_be.text: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

fatima_prayer.title: Fatima Prayer
fatima_prayer.text: O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to Heaven, especially those in most need of Thy mercy. Amen.

hail_holy_queen.title: Hail, Holy Queen
hail_holy_queen.text: Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness and our hope. To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve. To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy toward us, and after this our exile, show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary. Pray for us, O holy Mother of God, that we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ. Amen.

saint_michael.title: St. Michael Prayer
saint_michael.text: Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle; be our protection against the wickedness and snares of the devil. May God rebuke him, we humbly pray; and do thou, O Prince of the heavenly host, by the power of God, cast into hell Satan and all the evil spirits who prowl through the world seeking the ruin of souls. Amen.

Queen of Angels, pray for us.

mysteries.title: The Annunciation
mysteries.fruit_description: Mary receives God's message with trust and calls herself his servant. Ask for grace to surrender pride and welcome God's will with a humble heart.

mysteries.title: The Nativity
mysteries.fruit_description: Jesus is born in a humble manger, revealing that true riches are found in God. Ask for grace to loosen attachment to material wealth and treasure what draws the heart toward him.
